description: Turn a product photo into a product video ad that keeps the real product. Builds TikTok, Reels, TikTok Shop b-roll and listing videos from one to three product photos: a product truth sheet (label text letter by letter, colours, parts), a cut-out, a hero still, an 8–12 panel storyboard sheet, then one multi-shot Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 clip with a PRODUCT LOCK block, a repair pass on drifting shots, and the real packshot composited on the last second. Formats: hands-only ASMR unboxing, macro pour or texture, ingredient burst or exploded view, product in use, 360° loop, product in a hand, apparel try-on. Never ships a Ken Burns slideshow. Use when someone has product photos and wants a product video, packshot animation, unboxing, ASMR product video, listing video or AI b-roll without filming. NOT for a person talking about the product (use ai-ugc-ad-video), TikTok Shop presenter videos (use tiktok-shop-video), or still listing images (use a product-photo skill).
